knowledgeBase.answer: Your Clients page is your practitioner dashboard where you manage all your client connections. You can see new client matches, view their projects, send messages, and track the status of your engagements. It's your central hub for managing client relationships.

The 'New Clients' tab shows clients who have sent you connection requests for their wellness projects. Each client card displays their name, the service they're looking for, project details, and timestamps. You can review their information, accept to start messaging, or decline the match.

Each client card shows: their name and avatar, the wellness service they need, their location and travel preferences, project description, and action buttons. Click to expand for more details, or use the Connect button to accept the match and start messaging with the client.

To accept a client match, click the 'Connect with Client' button on their card. This changes your match status to 'In-Progress' and enables direct messaging with the client. They'll be notified that you've accepted and can now see you available to discuss their wellness needs.

To decline a client match, click the decline button (usually marked with an X or 'Decline'). You'll see a confirmation modal explaining that the client will be notified. Once confirmed, the match is declined and the client can search for other practitioners.

You can block a client to prevent them from matching with you in the future. When you block a client, they won't see your profile in their practitioner searches, and all pending matches between you will be declined. Use this if a client isn't a good fit for your practice.

Once you've accepted a client match, you can message them through your messaging thread. Click the client card to open the chat window, type your message, and hit send. Messages are saved in your thread history and you can refer back to previous conversations.

Each client card displays the project information they provided: their wellness category (nutrition, massage, etc.), the travel preference they selected (in-person, virtual, housecalls), their location (city/state/zip), urgency level, and their project description describing what they're looking for.

Match statuses show the stage of your engagement: Pending means you haven't responded yet, Active/In-Progress means you've accepted and can message, and Completed means the engagement ended (either hired or not hired by the client). Status is displayed on the client card.

Client cards display either their profile picture (if they've uploaded one) or their initials in a colored circle. The avatar makes it easy to visually identify clients in your list and shows their profile photo if they've shared one.

Client names are typically displayed as 'First Name Last Initial' for privacy (like 'Sarah M.'). This shows you who you're talking to while maintaining some privacy. Their full name may be visible once you start messaging or they share more details.

If your New Clients tab is empty, you haven't received any match requests yet. This is normal when you first join or if your specialties don't align with current client needs. Make sure your profile is complete, your match settings are configured, and that you're accepting matches for your specialties.

Access to new client matches requires an active membership with Rooted Vitality. If you see a membership notice, you need to activate or upgrade your membership to receive client matches. Go to your Settings page to view membership options.

You can view more about a client by clicking on their card or name. This shows their profile, wellness goals, any additional information they've shared, and communication preferences. This helps you understand if they're a good fit for your practice.

Each client provides a description of their wellness project - what they're trying to address, their goals, and relevant background. This description appears on their card and helps you decide if you can help them. They may share health history, current symptoms, or what they've already tried.

Client cards may show how they prefer to be contacted or their expected response time. Some clients prefer email follow-ups, while others want quick phone calls. Respect their preferences to build strong relationships.

You can typically filter or sort your client list by recent matches, client name, or wellness category to find specific clients. This helps when you have many pending requests and need to prioritize who to respond to first.

Some client cards show a match score indicating how well your profile aligns with their wellness needs. A higher score means your specialties, location, and service type closely match what they're looking for—making it a potentially strong fit.

Client contact information (phone, email) is available once you accept a match or during messaging. You'll never see their contact details if you decline a match. Once messaging is enabled, you can communicate directly through the platform.

After accepting a client match, send them a personalized first message. Introduce yourself, confirm you understand their wellness needs (referencing their project description), and suggest next steps like scheduling a consultation. A thoughtful first message builds trust.

Client cards may show badges indicating status (like 'New' for newly matched clients or 'Urgent' for high-priority requests). These badges help you quickly identify which matches need immediate attention.

To receive new client matches, you need to maintain an active membership with Rooted Vitality. Your membership status determines if you're visible to clients and eligible for matches. Check your Settings page to view your membership status and options.

Depending on the interface, you may be able to select multiple clients and perform bulk actions like declining several at once or organizing them. Look for checkboxes on client cards to enable bulk management features.

Your client list automatically updates when new matches come in. If it seems outdated, try refreshing the page. New client notifications will appear in real-time via toast notifications at the top of your screen.

Client information is maintained in your Rooted Vitality dashboard and can be accessed anytime. For backing up match data or exporting for your CRM, check your Settings page for export or integration options.

You can access your Inbox from the main dashboard. The Inbox displays all your client conversations in a message thread list on the left. Click any client thread to see your full conversation history and send new messages.

The Inbox has four filter tabs: (1) 'Messages' shows all active conversations, (2) 'Unread' shows only conversations with unread messages from clients, (3) 'Hired' shows clients who hired you, (4) 'Archive' shows declined and blocked clients. Each tab shows a badge count.

Badge counts appear on each inbox tab showing how many conversations are in that category. The 'Unread' tab badge shows how many clients have sent you unread messages. This helps you prioritize which conversations need immediate attention.
Use the search field in your inbox to find clients by name or search by message content. As you type, the conversation list filters in real-time to show only matching threads.

Each thread in your inbox list shows: the client's avatar and name, the last message preview, timestamp of the last message, and an unread indicator if there are new messages. Click any thread to open the full conversation.

Click a client's thread in the list to open the full message conversation. The right panel shows the complete message history with the client, timestamps for each message, and the message input area at the bottom to respond.

When you open a conversation, the message input area appears at the bottom of the thread. Type your message and click send. For archived or blocked conversations, the input area is disabled to prevent messaging.

Type your message in the input field at the bottom of the conversation thread and click the send button (or press Enter). Your message appears in the thread with a timestamp. The client receives it in real-time.

Messages from clients are marked as read when you open the conversation thread. The unread badge disappears once messages are read. Your messages to clients don't show read receipts, but you can see if they've opened your thread based on their response.

At the top of each conversation thread, you see the client's full information: their avatar, name, location (city/state), phone number (if shared), and online status indicator. Click the name or avatar to view their full profile.

Each thread shows the client's project details: the wellness category they need, their travel preference (in-person, virtual, housecalls), location and zip code, and their detailed project description. This helps you understand what they're seeking.

To archive a conversation, open it and click the menu button (three dots) at the top right. Select 'Archive' to decline the match and move it to the Archive tab. The client will be notified of the decline.

To block a client, open their conversation and click the menu button. Select 'Block' to permanently block this client. They won't be able to send you matches in the future, and all future messages are blocked. Use this for safety or compatibility reasons.

To unblock a previously blocked client, go to your Settings or open the Archive tab where blocked conversations appear. Find the blocked conversation, click the menu, and select 'Unblock' to allow messaging again.
When a client marks you as 'Hired', the match moves to your 'Hired' tab. The conversation remains visible and you can continue messaging the hired client. This marks the engagement as active/ongoing.

The Archive tab shows declined and blocked conversations. These threads are grayed out and message input is disabled. You can still view the message history with archived clients for reference, but cannot send new messages.

The conversation menu appears at the top right of each thread (three dots icon). From here you can archive the conversation, block the client, or access other conversation management options depending on the conversation status.
When a client sends you a message, it appears in real-time in your thread if you have the conversation open. You'll also see an unread badge update on the inbox 'Unread' tab immediately.

Your inbox has filter options to search by client project category (acupuncture, nutrition, massage, etc.) and service type. Use these filters to view only conversations related to specific wellness services you offer.

Your Match Settings page controls how you receive client matches. Here you can set your service offerings, coverage areas (in-person, housecalls, virtual), availability, timezone, and pause/resume matching. This determines which clients see you in their practitioner searches.

To enable matching, go to Match Settings and toggle matching ON. When matching is active, clients in your coverage area can find you and send connection requests. Your profile must be complete and you must set at least one service offering before matching is available.

You can pause matching temporarily without fully disabling it. Go to Match Settings and click 'Pause Matching'. You can set when you want to resume (e.g., tomorrow, next week). While paused, clients won't send you new matches, but your existing conversations remain active.

In Match Settings, select the wellness service categories you offer: acupuncture, nutrition, massage, yoga, coaching, energy work, herbalism, meditation, and more. Only select categories you actively provide. Clients searching for those services will match with you based on their needs and your coverage area.

To offer in-person sessions, enable 'In-Person' in Match Settings. Enter your base zip code where you practice, then select your service radius in miles. Clients within that radius will see your in-person availability and can match with you for office-based sessions.

To offer house calls, enable 'House Calls' in Match Settings. Enter your base zip code and service radius. You can specify additional zip codes where you provide house call services. Clients in those areas will see you available for home-based sessions.

To offer virtual sessions, enable 'Virtual' in Match Settings. Optionally specify which states you serve for virtual sessions. If you leave it open, you're available nationwide for virtual clients. This allows clients anywhere to match with you for online sessions.

For in-person and house call services, set your service radius in miles from your base zip code. This determines how far you're willing to travel. Clients within your radius will see your availability. For example, a 25-mile radius means you service clients within 25 miles of your base location.

Beyond your base zip code and radius, you can add specific additional zip codes where you provide services. This is useful if you have multiple office locations or regularly travel to certain areas. Clients in those zip codes will be matched with you as well.

For virtual sessions, you can optionally restrict service to specific states. If you don't select any states, you're available nationwide. This is useful if you're only licensed in certain states or prefer to serve specific regions for virtual sessions.

Set your timezone in Match Settings. This ensures clients see your availability in their correct local time and helps the system coordinate scheduling. Your timezone is also used to calculate your availability hours for each day of the week.

In Match Settings, set your availability hours for each day of the week. Specify which days you're available and your open/close times in your timezone. For example, Monday-Friday 9am-5pm, closed weekends. Clients see these hours when they request a match.

When a client searches for practitioners, the system calculates a match score based on: (1) Service category match, (2) Geography match (coverage area), (3) Your profile completeness, (4) Your reviews and ratings. Higher scores appear first to clients, but all qualifying matches appear in results.

Your profile completeness affects your match score and visibility. Complete all sections: basic info, credentials, practice details, services offered, availability, coverage areas, and a professional photo. A complete profile ranks higher in search results and receives more matches.

Your average review rating affects your match score. Clients are shown practitioners with higher ratings more prominently. After engagements, clients can leave reviews (1-5 stars). Maintain good reviews by providing excellent service and responding professionally to clients.

The matching system filters practitioners based on: (1) Service categories offered match what client requested, (2) Coverage area (zip code or state) matches client location, (3) Travel preference (in-person/housecalls/virtual) matches what practitioner offers. All criteria must match.

When a client selects 'Flexible' for travel preference, they're open to any delivery method (in-person, housecalls, or virtual). To match with flexible clients, you need to offer at least ONE delivery method (in-person OR housecalls OR virtual) in their geographic area.

To receive matches, you must have an active membership with Rooted Vitality. Only practitioners with active memberships appear in client search results and receive new match notifications. Check your Settings to verify your membership is current.

Match notifications depend on your preferences and how many clients are searching for your services. When a client sends a connection request, you receive a notification (in-app and email if enabled). Check your inbox regularly to see all incoming matches.

Your Profile page is where you manage all your professional information. Go to your practitioner dashboard and click 'Profile' to edit your bio, credentials, photos, practice details, languages, FAQs, insurance, and payment methods. Changes auto-save as you type.

Your profile completeness score reflects how much professional information you've added (0-100%). A complete profile includes: bio, credentials, professional photos, practice details, languages, FAQs, and service information. Higher completeness increases your visibility in search results.

Your bio is a professional summary clients see on your public profile. It should describe your practice, expertise, and approach to wellness. Write 50-500 words highlighting your unique qualifications, specializations, and how you work with clients.

Your ethos statement describes your overall approach to wellness and client care. This is your chance to share your practice philosophy, values, and what drives your work. Clients use this to understand if your values align with theirs.

Your professional photo or practice logo appears on your public profile and search results. Upload a high-quality image (at least 500x500px) that represents your practice professionally. This is the first thing clients see and affects their first impression.

Add up to 6 additional photos to showcase your practice. Include photos of your office, practice setting, wellness space, or you at work. These help clients visualize your practice environment and build trust through authenticity.

Add an introductory video (optional) where you introduce yourself and your practice. Keep it 30-60 seconds. This personal touch helps clients connect with you before booking and significantly increases engagement and match acceptance rates.

In the Credentials section, list your education (degrees), professional licenses, and certifications. For each, include institution/issuing body, credential name, and date obtained. Complete credentials build trust and enable credential verification badges on your profile.

Add your education credentials: degrees, diplomas, or formal training. Include institution name, field of study, and graduation date. This shows your foundational training and educational background to clients.

List your professional licenses (acupuncture license, massage license, etc.). Include the license number, issuing board/state, and expiration date. You can enable the 'Licensed' badge to show clients you have verified credentials.

Add professional certifications and specializations. Include certification name, issuing organization, and date. The 'Certified' badge appears on your profile when you add certifications, showing clients your specialized training.

Three badges appear on your profile: (1) Licensed badge shows you have professional licenses, (2) Certified badge shows you have certifications, (3) Background Check badge shows you've passed background verification. Badges build client trust.

The background check badge appears when you've passed a background verification process (if enabled by the platform). This badge signals to clients that you've undergone vetting and meet safety standards.
List languages you speak with clients. This is valuable for clients seeking practitioners who speak their native language. Select from common languages or add custom ones.

Your modalities are the specific healing practices or services you offer (acupuncture, massage, nutrition coaching, etc.). Select all modalities relevant to your practice. This helps clients find practitioners with their needed services.

List the health conditions and wellness areas you work with (stress, anxiety, chronic pain, fertility, etc.). This helps clients find practitioners experienced with their specific concerns. Select all relevant conditions.

Specify which insurance providers you accept and payment methods you offer (cash, card, checks, insurance, etc.). This helps clients understand cost and payment flexibility. You can add custom insurance providers if yours isn't listed.

Specify your practice type (private practice, group practice, clinic, etc.) and practice setting (office, home-based, mobile, etc.). This helps clients understand your practice structure and how sessions are conducted.
Enter the year you established your practice (or started if you don't have a business entity). This shows clients your experience and how long you've been serving the wellness community.

Add frequently asked questions clients ask you. For each question, provide your answer. FAQs help clients understand your practice better and reduce back-and-forth communication. Aim for 3-5 common questions.

Add links to your social media profiles and website. This helps clients learn more about you, see testimonials, and follow your wellness content. Include Instagram, Facebook, website, or other relevant platforms.

Your public profile is what clients see when they search for practitioners or review your match. It displays all your profile information: photo, bio, credentials, services, reviews, ratings, and coverage area. Review it regularly to ensure accuracy.

Your profile is visible in client search results when: (1) Your matching is enabled, (2) You have an active membership, (3) You're in the client's geographic coverage area, and (4) Your services match their needs. Complete profiles with good ratings rank higher.

Keep your profile fresh by updating photos annually, refreshing your bio if your practice evolves, and adding new credentials as you earn them. Current, detailed profiles receive more matches and higher client trust.

Your Settings page is where you manage all your account preferences, notifications, security, and profile visibility. Access it from your dashboard menu. The Settings page includes: Account settings, Notification preferences, Security options, Privacy settings, and Membership management.

Your Account settings section displays and allows you to edit your core business information: legal name, business name, DBA name, phone number, practice address, city, state, and zip code. These are shown to clients and used for verification and communication.

To change your email, go to Settings > Account Settings and click 'Edit' next to your email. Enter your new email address and verify it. Your email is used for login and to receive important account communications, so ensure it's current and accurate.

To change your password, go to Settings > Account Settings and click the password field. Enter your current password, then your new password (minimum 8 characters recommended). Your password should be strong and unique to protect your account from unauthorized access.

To update your phone number, go to Settings > Account Settings and click 'Edit' next to the phone field. Enter your new phone number. This number may be used by Rooted Vitality for account verification and by clients for potential contact.

To update your practice address, go to Settings > Account Settings and click 'Edit' next to the address fields. Update your street address, city, state, or zip code as needed. Your address helps clients understand your practice location and is used for location-based matching.

Your Notification Preferences let you customize how you receive alerts. For each notification type (messages, matches, reviews, promotions, system alerts), you can toggle: In-App Notifications, Email, and SMS. This gives you complete control over communication frequency and channels.

Messages notifications alert you when: a client messages you in a thread, or a client accepts your match request. You can receive these via In-App notification (banner in your dashboard), Email, or SMS. Default is enabled for all channels.

Matches notifications alert you when a client sends you a new connection request matching your services. You can toggle: In-App (notification on your dashboard), Email (message to your inbox), or SMS (text message). Stay on top of incoming opportunities.

Reviews notifications alert you when a client leaves you a rating or written review. Receive alerts via In-App notification, Email, or SMS. These help you stay informed about client feedback and respond promptly to reviews.

Promotions notifications are marketing emails about special offers, new features, or Rooted Vitality updates. Unlike other notifications, promotions default to OFF. You can enable In-App and Email notifications if you want to receive promotional content.

System notifications alert you about important account events: password changes, security updates, subscription reminders, and critical platform updates. These are essential and default to enabled for In-App and Email to ensure you don't miss important information.

Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security by requiring a second verification step when you log in. Go to Settings > Security and click 'Enable Two-Factor Authentication'. You'll scan a QR code with an authenticator app to complete setup.

To enable 2FA, use an authenticator app like Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy. In Settings > Security, click 'Enable 2FA', scan the QR code with your app, and enter the 6-digit code from your app to verify. Save backup codes in a safe place.

Backup codes are 10-digit codes provided when you enable 2FA. Store them in a safe place (password manager, secure file, etc.). If you lose access to your authenticator app, use a backup code to regain access to your account. Each code can only be used once.

To disable 2FA, go to Settings > Security and click 'Disable Two-Factor Authentication'. You'll need to confirm this action. Disabling 2FA removes the extra security layer, so your account will only require a password to log in.

Your Profile Visibility setting controls whether your profile appears in client search results. Set to 'Public' to be visible to clients searching for practitioners. Set to 'Private' to hide your profile (useful if you're not currently accepting clients). Your profile must be complete for visibility.

Your Privacy settings control how your data is used and shared. Important settings include: Profile visibility (public/private), Marketing emails opt-in/opt-out, and data sharing preferences. Your personal information is never sold to third parties.

To delete your practitioner profile, go to Settings > Security > 'Delete Practitioner Profile'. Your profile will be removed from Rooted Vitality, but you can still log in and use the platform as a client. Your account remains active and all data is preserved. You can create a new profile anytime.

To permanently delete your entire account, go to Settings > Security > 'Delete My Account'. This action CANNOT be undone and will delete: your profile, all messages, activity history, and all account data. You'll need to confirm with a confirmation code. Contact support if you have questions.

Your Memberships section shows your current subscription status with Rooted Vitality. View your active membership plan, renewal date, and billing information. Click to upgrade, downgrade, or change your plan. Note: You need an active membership to receive client matches.

To upgrade your membership, go to Settings > Memberships. Review available plans with their features and pricing. Click 'Upgrade' to select a new plan. Your billing will be adjusted based on your current plan cycle. Upgrades take effect immediately.

Your membership billing shows: current plan name and cost, renewal date, payment method on file, and billing history. Manage your payment method here. Auto-renewal ensures your membership stays active without interruption.
